race.comment: TROY BOY (4) is a speedy gelding stepping up from some short course trips this season, and trying 1100m, which is a query. A good draw here will help, and having Ryan Wiggins in the saddle is also a strong lead for the stable. He goes on top for us. VICKERS VIMY (5) makes his debut from the coveted pole position, and he hails from the astute David Vandyke stable, who has a strong record when racing his team on this circuit. He has won a trial, and is ready to rumble. ON THE CUSP (9) was runner-up in each of her 2 starts as a juvenile, and she has won a tune-up trial for this very easily. She won't be in this grade for long. MAKE ME SHINE (1) resumes from a spell, and her trial form has been solid enough. She has some scope, and is worth including in all top 4 combos.
